Class FileBasedConfigProvider<T>

java.lang.Object
me.bristermitten.mittenlib.config.provider.FileBasedConfigProvider<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the type of the config
All Implemented Interfaces:
Provider<T>, jakarta.inject.Provider<T>, javax.inject.Provider<T>, ConfigProvider<T>, SaveableConfigProvider<T>
public class FileBasedConfigProvider<T> extends Object implements SaveableConfigProvider<T>
A ConfigProvider that reads and writes from a file, using a ConfigReader

    • path

      public Optional<Path> path()
      Description copied from interface: ConfigProvider
      The path of the source for the config, if available

      This is not always required - if the config came from a URL or String, for example, then this would be expected to return an Optional.empty()

      However, if it is coming from the file system (in most cases, it will), then a filled optional should be returned to allow things like FileWatchingConfigProvider to be implemented.

      Specified by:
      path in interface ConfigProvider<T>
      Returns:
      The path for of the config's source

    • clearCache

      public void clearCache()
      Description copied from interface: ConfigProvider
      Clear any and all cached config, if applicable. If this is a WrappingConfigProvider, then this method should also be called on the result of WrappingConfigProvider.getWrapped().

      This may be a no-op if the config is not cached.

      Specified by:
      clearCache in interface ConfigProvider<T>

    • save

      public Result<DataTree> save(T instance)
      Description copied from interface: SaveableConfigProvider
      Saves the given config instance back to the file. This can be used to save default values for missing fields. By default, this only adds missing fields and does not override existing ones.
      Specified by:
      save in interface SaveableConfigProvider<T>
      Parameters:
      instance - the config instance to save
      Returns:
      a Result indicating success or failure, containing the exact DataTree that was written
